issues.where: clouds across the whole globe, worst on the west limb and Pacific (crops D, N, S, T of image-06/07/08)
issues.what: clouds break up into small square blocks and smeared tiles; the cloud layer looks like a low-resolution texture that was stretched, with visible pixels and blocky compression patterns
issues.fix: use a much higher-resolution cloud map for the close-up and filter it properly (mipmaps or anisotropic filtering); do not upscale the far-view texture

issues.where: lower half: South America, Andes coast and the Pacific clouds (crops G, T, U, V)
issues.what: strong directional streaks and smearing that look like broken motion blur or a texture stretched along one axis; terrain and clouds lose all detail and turn to streaks
issues.fix: remove or fix the motion-blur pass, or fix the UV stretch near the bottom of the view so the texture stays sharp

issues.where: Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Central America (crops A, F, O, P)
issues.what: bright white specks scattered over sea and land like noise or sparkles; they read as an artifact rather than small clouds or city lights
issues.fix: clamp or remove the speck layer; if they are meant as cumulus or lights, make them smaller and softer and keep lights off the day side

issues.where: dark side on the right (crops E, I, Q, V)
issues.what: night side is soft and mushy, cloud swirls are blurry ghosts, and city lights are smeared into short dashes
issues.fix: sharpen the night-side textures and draw city lights as points without the streak blur

issues.where: upper right limb, aurora (crops C, L, M)
issues.what: aurora is a row of hard-edged, saturated green blobs sitting on top of the limb, with a red glow behind; it looks pasted on and does not follow the planet's curve smoothly
issues.fix: make the aurora thinner and more translucent, follow the curve of the atmosphere, and soften the edges of each curtain

issues.where: South America, east coast and interior (crops H, Q)
issues.what: city lights show on land that is still in daylight, so the night-light layer is not masked by the terminator
issues.fix: mask the city-light layer with the day/night terminator so lights appear only on the dark side

issues.where: right limb near the terminator (crops E, I, R)
issues.what: a faint doubled edge or hard rim where the dark globe meets the sky; the atmosphere glow stops on the night side
issues.fix: carry a faint atmosphere rim across the terminator and blend the limb edge

issues.where: globe surface overall (crops A, G, P)
issues.what: surface looks slightly airbrushed and over-saturated, with very bright turquoise shallows and a plastic feel
issues.fix: lower saturation of the shallows and add fine surface detail

issues.what: moon is small and soft with little detail and its lit side does not clearly match the sun direction on Earth
issues.fix: use a sharper moon texture and light it from the same direction as Earth

issues.where: outer globe across South America, South Atlantic, and lower-left Pacific (crops image-14.png D, E, H; image-15.png P, Q; image-16.png T, U, V)
issues.what: heavy radial smearing blurs terrain and clouds toward the edges, producing visible diagonal corduroy banding and pixelated stair-stepped streaks across the lower-left Pacific clouds
issues.fix: remove radial or lens-edge blur and render full-resolution cloud and surface detail cleanly all the way to the limb without directional smearing or Moire striping

issues.where: Andes, Amazon basin, Central America, and North America surfaces and clouds (crops image-14.png A, H; image-15.png J, K, P)
issues.what: landmasses appear soft, plastic, and airbrushed with exaggerated baked relief, blotchy blurred cloud patches over the Amazon and US East Coast, and blocky low-resolution coastlines around Hudson Bay and Greenland
issues.fix: increase albedo, normal, coastline, and cloud-map resolution so terrain and cloud edges remain crisp and natural at 1:1 crop scale

issues.where: night-side Atlantic coast of South America (crops image-14.png E; image-16.png V)
issues.what: coastal city lights are stretched into blurry radial streaks that cut off abruptly along a curved patch edge at the shoreline
issues.fix: render sharp point-level night lights aligned to high-resolution land masks without radial blur or hard patch boundaries

issues.where: upper-right aurora and dark right limb (crops image-14.png C; image-15.png L, R; image-16.png W)
issues.what: the aurora reads as a soft airbrushed 2D glow with a segmented lower edge along the limb, and background stars remain brightly visible directly through the aurora and atmospheric haze
issues.fix: model the aurora as a smooth 3D volumetric emission shell above the limb and attenuate background stars behind bright auroral and atmospheric layers

issues.where: upper-left Milky Way and sunlit left limb (crops image-14.png B, G, I; image-16.png S)
issues.what: stars in the Milky Way region appear as soft multi-pixel blobs with color noise, and a wide overbright cyan-white halo washes across the adjacent starfield
issues.fix: tighten star point-spread profiles, denoise the Milky Way background plate, and narrow the sunlit limb scattering falloff

issues.where: blue atmospheric horizon band across the limb (crops image-10.png B, C; image-11.png J, K, L, M)
issues.what: a thin dark concentric line creates a subtle doubled edge between the bright lower horizon haze and the upper blue Rayleigh glow
issues.fix: smooth the vertical atmospheric density transition so no dark seam line appears inside the limb gradient

issues.what: a clipped sun-glare haze enters from the top border with faint gradient banding in the dark sky falloff
issues.fix: remove the clipped border glare or apply clean 16-bit dithering to eliminate banding in the dark sky gradient
